topics.topic: Security-review model scope after removal of M08–M12
questions: After M08–M12 were removed, does this category apply only to the surviving models among M01–M15, or are replacement authentication concepts intended for the now-undefined model identifiers?
Does “M01-M15” mean only the surviving models in that numeric span, or is the security-review evidence incomplete or invalid until its affected-model set is rewritten explicitly?

After M08–M12 were removed, does this security category cover only the surviving identity models M01–M07 and M13–M15, or are later agents expected to retain some security obligation corresponding to the removed models?

quotes:
- **No email challenges.** The accepted spec split them into
  `staff_challenges` (Factory `f12197b46a82`) and kept its operations inert;
  the owner removed them on 2026-11-07 with `deliver_email_message` and
  `create_email_delivery_schema` (R0-23). The former `create_staff_account`
  with a verification challenge is the administrator activation of R0-19.

Email of any kind (there is none, A10), project authorization, viewer or
service credentials, HTTP cookies or headers, or role-capability tables. It
sends no notice.
judgement.why: State 3 and State 5 explicitly remove the challenge capabilities and module, so later agents retain no replacement obligation for M08–M12 and apply the review only to surviving authentication concepts.

topics.topic: Eligibility conditions for administrative recovery email override
questions: May an authorized administrator invoke the recovery override for any login-email replacement, including a routine change, or must the operation verify some recovery condition; if so, what condition and evidence?

Beyond administrator authorization and ordinary email validity/uniqueness, what condition makes an email replacement an eligible recovery override, and which calls must be refused as non-exceptional ordinary email changes?

quotes:
7. `capability:staff_identity.perform_recovery_override` replaces the login
   email with the given normalized address, sets `email_verified_at` and
   appends `staff.recovery_override` atomically.

Access-management failures; `IdentityInputRejected` for the replacement email;
`ScopedNotFoundError` for an unknown account.
judgement.why: The later flow and public-operation contract impose no recovery-evidence predicate: after administrator authorization, only replacement-email validation and account existence can refuse the operation.

questions: What is the exact surviving IAM invariant ID set: does the literal range still include INV-010 through INV-013, or must later closures treat those IDs as nonexistent?
